create.name: Ronan Rooney
create.bio:
Ronan Rooney is an Irish spiritual teacher, author and speaker who spent many years working as a chartered surveyor and property arbitrator before making the inner life his main work. He studied philosophy and applied mathematics and later took a master's degree in consciousness, spirituality and transpersonal psychology; he is also trained as a Primordial Sound Meditation instructor and as a transpersonal coach. His teaching draws together self-inquiry, universal principles, meditation and ideas from psychology and science, and he says he has been exploring these questions for more than thirty-seven years.

Much of his work is aimed at people in business who feel that outward success has left a deeper question unanswered. Through his NEXUS Self Mastery online membership he offers recorded teachings, guided meditations and monthly live calls, arranged in stages that move from personal and mental work towards spirit. He also gives one-to-one coaching, leads a small six-month group programme that ends with a retreat in Tiruvannamalai, India, near the ashram of Ramana Maharshi, and hosts the Reality Podcast. His three books, which he presents as a trilogy, begin with The Secret of Life, continue with The True Nature of Our Reality and close with Conscious Awareness.

courses.title: NEXUS Self Mastery membership
courses.description: An online membership with a library of his recorded talks, writings, guided meditations and exercises, grouped into personal, mind, life and spirit levels. Members also get weekly messages and live monthly calls for questions.

courses.title: Coaching with Ronan Rooney
courses.description: One-to-one sessions that combine spiritual guidance with transpersonal coaching, offered mainly to professionals looking for purpose and a clearer sense of who they are.

courses.title: The Mastery Odyssey
courses.description: A six-month small-group programme taken a month at a time, with live mentoring, that closes with a guided retreat of about ten days in Tiruvannamalai, including time at Ramanashram.

courses.title: The NEXUS Blueprint LIVE Event
courses.description: A yearly one-day seminar, formerly called the Sirius Awakening Seminar, in which he takes a room through the main stages of his self-mastery teaching with exercises and guided visualisations. Visitors can register interest for the next one.

free_resources.title: Ronan Rooney on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His free guided meditations on the Insight Timer app.

free_resources.title: Reality Podcast with Ronan Rooney
free_resources.description: His podcast of mostly solo episodes on consciousness, self-inquiry and finding purpose, with occasional guests. Free on the main podcast apps.
